title: File:Research Specialist Heather Furey prepares an Argo float (OOI 261).jpg
desc: Research Specialist Heather Furey prepares an Argo float for deployment off the stern of the R/V Armstrong. The yellow straps are used to deploy the float while it is still in the box. The cardboard biodegrades in the water and releases the float. Photo by J. Batryn©Woods Hole Oceanographic Institut
